rules: Only supabase/migrations/ is the canonical Supabase CLI migration stream.
database/archive/ contains provenance, pending forward reconciliation, and unapplied proposals; it is never executable or part of CLI discovery/replay.
Each of the 62 production ledger versions maps to exactly one canonical migration filename and Git blob.
The production migration ledger stores version/name metadata only; reconstructed SQL bodies are not claimed to be byte-identical to original applied bodies.
Compound historical sources are split across their exact production version filenames; uncertain original boundaries are explicitly labeled reconstructed.
Folded historical versions remain explicit no-op migrations with provenance notes.
No real administrator identity is hardcoded or seeded; synthetic admin seed exists only in a test fixture.
No migration is authorized for local or production execution until clean disposable replay and catalog parity review pass.
The 66-file CLI stream contains 62 historical production-ledger migrations plus 4 new forward-reconciliation migrations; the latter are not represented as already applied in the production ledger.

knownReplayBlockers.issue: The full disposable replay applied the historical-to-final membership transition. The Forever membership-number workflow passed, and post-forward direct-conversation eligibility checks verified active membership, verified membership number, final format, and confirmed Auth email. Production remains unchanged.

Post-forward active-membership restrictive RLS assertions and rollback-only authenticated CRUD/RPC compatibility tests passed in disposable local Supabase. No unguarded application policy was observed in the runtime assertions.
Disposable-local preflight and postflight verified pgcrypto is installed in extensions and extensions.digest(bytea,text) plus extensions.gen_random_bytes(integer) resolve.
The reviewed purge-job definition was verified and the loopback-only disposable pg_cron probe executed a temporary SELECT 1 job successfully with scoped cleanup.
Disposable-local preflight verified Auth, Storage, Realtime schemas, auth.users, auth.uid(), storage objects, Realtime publication, and required API roles; local Auth and Storage API probes passed.

Forward migration 20261112160001 passed disposable-local replay. Storage API probes passed valid chat-media upload, member signed-read, cross-user uploader-folder spoof denial, private-document share controls, and avatar owner-upsert checks. Production still uses the pre-migration policy until the forward migration is separately approved and applied.

Forward migration 20261112160000 and post-forward SQL assertions passed in disposable local Supabase. Twenty-four reversed-pair concurrent requests converged on one direct conversation; 40 authenticated message writes persisted uniquely. Production RPC remains unchanged until the forward migration is separately approved and applied.

Forward migration 20261112160000 passed caller/target eligibility, active membership, verified-number, final-format, confirmed-email, and RPC ACL assertions in disposable local Supabase. The production RPC remains unchanged until the forward migration is separately approved and applied.

Forward migrations 20261112160002 and 20261112160003 passed disposable-local least-privilege, restrictive active-membership RLS, and rollback-only CRUD/RPC tests. Production postgres-owned defaults are addressed by the migration. Supabase-managed supabase_admin defaults remain broad and cannot be changed by postgres because it is not a member of that superuser role; read-only production inspection found zero public relations/functions owned by supabase_admin. Keep production deployment gated on Supabase-level review of this external default-ACL residual.
